params.message:
Approved only for Ask; rejected and unwritten trends for the Studio

- Ask for members reads only trends a person approved (approvedFor), not
  the ones carried over from before the check.
- GET /insight-checks also returns the rejected trends (rejectedList), and
  every line carries the published posts that cite it.
- Story starters return the approved trends no published post is about
  yet (unwrittenApproved), for Write.
- /site/trends returns published posts per sector (postSectors);
  postsByTrend is split out of siteTrendsOverview and reused.

Portal: Ask Gen antwoordt alleen nog met goedgekeurde trends, en de Studio toont per sector hoeveel trends en posts er zijn en waarover nog niet geschreven is.
